items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: I mean I really love art. I mean I love DeChirico and all sorts of people.

ctx.x: Yeah. But they would get together, all these artists and they would share ideas and they’d have little exhibitions of their own work to each other and talk about they’re working on this and then they’d all say yeah, oh yeah, okay good, let’s try — you know, and they’re selling their paintings like $500 was a huge amount to get for a painting for one of these people, you know guys. And then this guy come along who said, “I can turn this into a big business.” And he did. And I don’t know his name but he was like an…
There’s no physical product — like I see what you’re saying. Of course you can record it but it doesn’t have the same — it’s not tangible.
